note: Written for a mixed-age Australian lounge room: a nine year old and a grandparent should both be able to answer honestly, in front of each other. Nothing about drinking, romance, money or anything a guest would rather not say out loud.
words: Has set off a smoke alarm cooking
Has locked themselves out
Has assembled furniture with pieces left over
Has a drawer that will not close
Has painted a room
Has killed a houseplant
Has hung a picture crooked and left it
Has a cupboard they would not open in front of guests
Has fixed something with tape
Has lost the remote for more than a day
Has rearranged a room at midnight
Has a chair with clothes on it
Has burnt toast this week
Has washed something that should not have been washed
Has found money in a coat
Has a jar of odd screws
Has argued about the thermostat
Has left washing on the line in the rain
Has vacuumed up something they needed
Has bought something twice by accident
Has a shed or garage they cannot park in
Has ironed something while wearing it
Has stubbed a toe on the same thing twice
Has moved a heavy thing alone they should not have
Has changed a tyre
